units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 27:15">Targ. Prov. XXVII, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 72:6">Targ. Ps. LXXII, 6</cite> <he>דנָטְפִין</he> (ed. Wil. <he>דנָטְפֵי</he>).—
B. Bath. 73ᵇ לא נַטְפָא ניטופתא וכ׳ not a drop fell to the ground.—נָטְפֵי (= h. נוטפים, v. preced.) dripping rain water, contrad. to שפכי rain water collected in spouts (v. מַרְזֵב).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 6a:12">Ib. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אחזיק לנ׳ וכ׳</he> if one has the right to let the dripping water from his roof run into his neighbor’s yard, he may make spouts and gutters &c.

<cite ref="Ketubot 60a:3">Keth. 60ᵃ</cite> (to a woman who had her eyes cast down in order not to look at her child) <he>נְטוֹף עיניך</he> Rashi (ed. <he>נטף</he>) turn thy eyes up (look freely around).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 68:9">Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 9</cite>; a. e.—V. <cite ref="I00195"><he>טוּף</he></cite>.
